name: Curved Monitor
description: Redraws the picture so it looks flat to a viewer sitting in front of a curved monitor. The monitor is a cylinder of the given radius, as wide as its height times the picture's aspect ratio.

params.label: Curvature radius (mm)
params.doc: The radius of the monitor's curve in millimetres; a 1500R monitor is 1500.

params.label: Viewing distance (cm)
params.doc: How far the viewer's eyes are from the middle of the screen.

params.label: Screen height (cm)
params.doc: The height of the visible screen; the width follows from the picture's aspect ratio.

params.label: Border zoom
params.doc: Zooms the corrected picture out below 1 and in above 1, to show or hide the borders.

params.label: Mirror border
params.doc: Fills the border with a mirrored copy of the picture instead of a colour.

params.label: Border colour
params.doc: The colour and opacity of the border.

params.label: Background dim
params.doc: How much the border is darkened.
